summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature across rich/tree.py, rich/align.py, rich/console.py, tests/test_align.py, tests/test_tree.py, and CHANGELOG.md, following the specification. Tree.__rich_measure__ walks the tree iteratively with an explicit stack and adds 4 cells per indent level. Align now constrains its renderable to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and the explicit width) and has a __repr__. VerticalCenter is a new public class in rich/align.py with render, measure, and repr methods. Console.print now renders collected renderables with justify="default". Tests were added to test_align.py and test_tree.py, and the CHANGELOG 9.8.0 section was updated. Tests were not run, per instructions, so the expected values were derived by hand. Nothing was committed.
